summary: Apollo Debt Solutions BDC filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of 384,867 Class I common shares sold as of May 1, 2026, for $9,204,625 aggregate consideration, exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation S. The filing also announces monthly distributions ($0.18/share for Class I) and provides April 2026 performance data: NAV of $23.92, portfolio of $25.7 billion in first-lien floating-rate debt across 404 companies, and net leverage of 0.75x. This is a routine capital raise and periodic disclosure, not a special situation.
